de1.P1.C7.ghi_chu: Cac phuong an bi mat chi so goc (chi con 'sin = cos' x2 va 'tan = cot' x2, khong con alpha/beta) nen khong khoi phuc duoc phuong an dung duy nhat. Can doi chieu anh/file de goc, khong doan dap an.

de1.P1.C6.ghi_chu: Phuong an D trong goi thieu dau bat dang thuc ('3x - 2  0', khong doc duoc la >, >=, < hay <=). Dap an D van la phuong an duy nhat co the la bat phuong trinh bac nhat mot an (A bac 3, B he so 0x, C bac 2) nhung khong tu dien dau khi chua xem de goc - nho thay xac nhan dau cua phuong an D.
